title: Geometric Dictionary Learning of Dynamical Systems with Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2605.18276v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning dynamical systems through operator-theoretic representations provides a powerful framework for analyzing complex dynamics, as spectral quantities such as eigenvalues and invariant structures encode characteristic time scales and long-term behavior. However, dynamical operators are typically estimated independently for each system, preventing the discovery of shared structure across related dynamics. To address this limitation, we posit that related dynamical systems lie near a low-dimensional manifold in spectral operator space. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce DOODL (Dynamical OperatOr Dictionary Learning), a framework that learns a dictionary of characteristic spectral dynamics whose combinations approximate this manifold and yield compact, interpretable embeddings of individual systems. translated_title: 基于最优传输的动力学系统几何字典学习
translated_abstract: 通过算子理论表示来学习动力学系统，为分析复杂动力学提供了一个强大的框架，因为特征值和不变结构等谱量编码了特征时间尺度和长期行为。然而，动力学算子通常是对每个系统独立估计的，这阻碍了对相关动力学之间共享结构的发现。为解决这一局限，我们假设相关的动力学系统位于谱算子空间中的一个低维流形附近。基于这一假设，我们提出了DOODL（Dynamical OperatOr Dictionary Learning，动力学算子字典学习），这是一个学习特征谱动力学字典的框架，其线性组合可近似该流形，并为单个系统产生紧凑且可解释的嵌入。除表示学习之外，DOODL还能从短的、部分观测的轨迹中实现快速且可解释的算子估计
tldr: 提出DOODL框架，通过最优传输在谱算子空间中学习动力学系统字典，揭示相关动力学系统的共享低维流形结构，并实现从短且部分观测数据中快速、可解释的算子估计
en_tdlr: DOODL learns a dictionary of spectral dynamics via optimal transport to uncover a shared low-dimensional manifold structure across related dynamical systems, enabling fast and interpretable operator estimation from short, partially observed trajectories
